about: ASK 417 exercise registry (plan W3 a417_w3/plan_rev1.md, build W2). One entry per live package. case_sql and mark_sql are SQL expressions over the CTEs r (debate_results row of the run), j (its debate_judgments rows), e (its debate_enforcer_log rows) and x (debate_errors rows in the run window: 3 hours before r.created_at to 10 minutes after; debate_errors has no run_token). case_sql is boolean; mark_sql is a count, or null when no mark is defined. probe: 'sql', 'NOT IN DB' or 'NO PROBE'. live_since is the UTC save time of the engine version that made the package live (n8n workflow history of moMxiV4Irg1uRBZN, matched to W4's write posts).

packages.title: D3 Build ASSUMES sentence (defender answers an assumed-fact charge)
packages.case_sql: exists(select 1 from e where e.rule='E-ASSUME' and e.item like 'CHALLENGER PREMISE%')

packages.title: both-not-stated refusal of DEFENDER LINK BROKEN on a challenger premise
packages.case_sql: exists(select 1 from e, j where e.rule='E-ASSUME' and e.item like 'CHALLENGER PREMISE%' and e.cure_reason like 'BOTH NOT STATED%' and j.verdict_raw ~ ('D[0-9]+ vs C' || substring(e.item from 'CHALLENGER PREMISE ([0-9]+)') || '[^0-9][^\n]*DEFENDER LINK BROKEN'))
packages.mark_sql: (select count(*) from j where j.verdict_raw like '%(pkgBNS, ASK 374)%') + (select count(*) from e where coalesce(e.cure_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(e.response_line,'') like '%(pkgBNS, ASK 374)%')

packages.title: K-V exclusion wording counts as a K-V kind (KV_EXCL)
packages.case_sql: exists(select 1 from e where e.rule='K-V' and lower(coalesce(e.full_reply,'')||' '||coalesce(e.cure_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(e.flagged_line,'')) like '%exclu%')
packages.mark_sql: (select count(*) from e where e.rule='K-V' and e.cure_status='CURED' and lower(coalesce(e.full_reply,'')||' '||coalesce(e.cure_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(e.flagged_line,'')) like '%exclu%')

packages.title: bnsRefuse2024 reads the CHANGE TO line by __RL.readLine

packages.title: alternate order (ember, glm_legal, ...)

packages.title: every reader of the defender's declared chain takes one link head (D1:, D1., **1.**, 1 --)
packages.note: Case (W1 8969 F1): after DECLARED CHAIN in the defender's round 1, a line takes the ASK 424 head and no line takes the old head (digits then . or ), as drvLinks read before). Over the 245 stored chains it selects exactly the 16 runs R2 to R5 newly read (a424_w4/r6/out424_r2.txt), 4 of them with D<n>: heads (SQL by W2 at 00:11Z 11-19, over all 880 results rows). No mark: the prompts that show the read chain are not stored, so a case reads CASE, READ BY HAND. Read by hand: D4 Build's YOUR DECLARED CHAIN carries the conclusion link; an 'AGAINST DECLARED CHAIN COUNT 0' N CHECK in review_notes on a case run is a MISS (W1 8969 N2; the registry has no partial mark form, so it stays a hand read).
